DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の写真、店の中のお客様まで写っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Does the photo you just took also show customers inside the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 確認します。奥の席の方の顔が見えていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人物の写り込みを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Let me check. I can see the face of someone seated at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether any people appear in the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人が写っている写真の公開は慎重にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please be careful about publishing photos with people in them.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ送っていません。この一枚は送らずにおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送信の写真を公開しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't sent it yet. I'll leave this photo unsent.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide not to publish the photo that has not been sent yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物だけなら、外から角度を変えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want just the building, you can change the angle from outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓を外して、看板と壁だけ撮ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮り直す範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I take another photo showing only the sign and wall, leaving the windows out?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which area you may photograph again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 店内にカメラを向けず、入口も空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't point the camera inside the shop, and keep the entrance clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口から離れます。撮り直した写真も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影位置と確認手順を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move away from the entrance. I'll check the new photo too.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Adjust where you take the photo and how you check it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 人が入っていないか見てくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check that no people are in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。新しい写真には誰も写っていません。これを友人に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人物のない写真を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. There is nobody in the new photo. I'll send this one to my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a photo with no people in it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご配慮ありがとうございます。町歩きを楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for being considerate. Enjoy your walk around town.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 次回の案内は受け取られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you received the information about your next visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、この検査名が読めなくて、家族に説明できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない検査名を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I can't read this test name, so I can't explain it to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the test name you cannot read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの欄ですね。担当者に確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field here, right? Shall I check with the person in charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。自分で別の検査名だと思い込んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自己判断を訂正して確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I mistakenly assumed on my own that it was a different test.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your own assumption and ask for confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 準備の説明はまだ受けていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you not received the preparation instructions yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。食事のことも、この紙だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 準備説明の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. This sheet alone doesn't tell me what to do about meals either.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not yet confirmed the preparation instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も担当者に聞く必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You'll need to ask the person in charge about that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞きたいことを、検査名と食事の二つにまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 質問を二点に整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll organize my questions into two points: the test name and meals.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Organize your questions into two points. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内を持ったまま、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait here with the information sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。家族への連絡は説明を聞いてからにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族への説明を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll contact my family after I hear the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put off explaining it to your family for now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者に二点を伝えますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass those two points to the person in charge. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the documents for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、同じ袋に家族の別の書類も入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 関連資料と家族書類の混在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the same bag also contains my family's documents about another matter.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the relevant documents are mixed with your family's documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の件と関係がある物から見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the items related to this matter first.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメッセージの記録が今回のものです。家族の請求書は違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回の資料を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This record of messages relates to this matter. My family's bill does not.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the documents for this matter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 関係のない書類は袋へ戻して構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can put the unrelated documents back in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻します。記録には相手の文と、私の返事が両方あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別件を戻し双方のやり取りを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put them back. The record contains both the other person's messages and my replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put away the unrelated documents and show both sides of the exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 前後が分かる形で拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll look at them in a way that shows the context.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の返事を隠さず、やり取りの順に並べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の返信も含め順に並べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll arrange the exchange in order, without hiding my own replies.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Arrange the messages in order, including your own replies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その順序を担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain that order to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。個別の一文だけでなく、届いた文と返した文を続けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 前後関係を担当へ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Rather than explaining just an isolated sentence, I'll explain the received messages and my replies together in sequence.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the context to the person in charge. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その記録を持って相談担当へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take that record to the consultation staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この組合せをご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to look at this outfit combination?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 全部で一つの商品だと思っていました。別々に買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示の組合せが別売りか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought all of it was a single item. Can I buy the pieces separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the pieces displayed together are sold separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。上着と中の服は別売りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. The jacket and the clothing underneath are sold separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中の服は家に似たものがあるので、上着だけ試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手持ち服を踏まえ上着だけ試す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have something similar to the inner garment at home, so I'd like to try just the jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Try just the jacket, considering the clothes you already own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが上着の価格です。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the price of the jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 上下の合計ではなく、この上着の価格ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一着分の価格を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So this is the price of this jacket, rather than the total for the top and bottom?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the price for one garment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。いつもの服の上から試してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please try it over your usual clothes.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 着てみました。袖は合いますが、前を閉じると少し窮屈です。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前を閉じた着心地を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've tried it on. The sleeves fit, but it feels a little tight when I fasten the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe how it feels with the front fastened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一つ上のサイズもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also have the next size up.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そちらは前を閉じても動けます。上着だけ、このサイズを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別サイズを比較し一着を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: In that one, I can move even with the front fastened. I'll buy just the jacket in this size.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare another size and choose one garment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、上着一着をそのサイズでご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll prepare one jacket in that size for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 下処理もこちらでしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like us to do the preparation here too?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家で切る練習をしたいですが、骨の位置が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭で切る練習と骨の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to practice cutting it at home, but I don't know where the bones are.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to practice cutting at home but do not know where the bones are. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この見本で大きな骨の位置を説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can explain where the large bones are using this sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。頭を外すだけで、全部の骨がなくなるわけではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 頭処理と全骨除去を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Removing the head alone doesn't mean all the bones are gone, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish removing the head from removing all the bones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 細かな骨もあるので、調理のときに確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are small bones too, so you'll need to check when cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、頭の処理だけお願いして、身は家で切ってみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店に頼む処理を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then please just deal with the head, and I'll try cutting the flesh at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the limited preparation you want the shop to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご家族も召し上がりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will your family be eating it too?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。骨がない料理とは伝えず、残る可能性を話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ骨の可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't tell them it is a boneless dish; I'll explain that bones may remain.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain to your family that bones may remain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明を覚えられそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you think you can remember the explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見本で示してもらった位置をメモしました。分からない所は調理前に聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 骨の位置を記録し不明時に再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted down the locations you showed me on the sample. I'll ask again about anything I don't understand before cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the bone locations and ask again if anything is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、頭の処理をして、持ち帰りの説明も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll deal with the head and include instructions for taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 資料をご覧になれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you been able to look through the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 文字が小さくて、必要な部分を読み切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 文字の読みにくさを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: The print is small, so I can't finish reading the part I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the text is difficult to read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 申請する人の条件です。そこを大きな文字で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要な項目と表示を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The eligibility requirements for applicants. I'd like to see that in larger print.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the section you need and how you would like it displayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 大きい版があるか確認します。読み上げもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check whether there is a large-print version. We can read it aloud too.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず、その項目を読んでいただけますか。聞きながらメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読み上げ補助を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you read that section aloud first? I'll take notes as I listen.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for help by having the text read aloud. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 途中で止めても構いませんよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can stop me partway through.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の「同じ世帯」のところで止めてください。意味も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 途中で止めて用語を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please stop at the phrase 'same household' you just read. I'd like to check its meaning too.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the reader to stop and check a term. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者から具体的な説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's have the person in charge explain it in detail.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。拡大版がなくても、条件を確認できる方法でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 代替手段で条件確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Even if there isn't a larger version, please help me confirm the requirements in another way.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the requirements through an alternative method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者に資料の見えづらさと質問を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about your difficulty reading the documents and your question.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この入金一覧が売上の資料ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: This deposit list is your sales documentation, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、現金で受け取った分はここにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入金一覧にない現金売上を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But the amounts I received in cash aren't listed here.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Disclose cash sales that are not on the deposit list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その分の記録もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have records of those amounts too?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の帳面にあります。今日は持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不足している帳面の所在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: They're in the shop's ledger. I haven't brought it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where the missing ledger is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行の一覧だけで全体を確認するのは難しいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be difficult to check the whole picture from the bank's list alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一覧にないからゼロとはせず、帳面も用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未掲載をゼロと扱わず資料を補う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't treat unlisted amounts as zero. I'll prepare the ledger too.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Provide additional records without treating unlisted amounts as zero. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じ売上を後で銀行に入れた分はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you later deposit any of that same sales revenue in the bank?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。受取日と入金日が違うので、二重に足さないよう照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取日と後日入金の二重集計を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The receipt date and deposit date differ, so I'd like to match them to avoid adding them twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about avoiding double counting receipts and later deposits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応する記録を並べて相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the corresponding records together for the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現金の受取記録と後日の入金を分け、対応を確認してから合計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二記録を照合して集計すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish the cash receipt records from the later deposits, confirm which ones correspond, and then calculate the total.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to match the two records before calculating the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、帳面を含めた資料で改めて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check again using the documents including the ledger.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小銭入れだけ出してしまいました。紙幣は別のかばんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支払いに使う財布の所在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've only taken out my coin purse. My banknotes are in another bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain where the wallet you will use for payment is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お席に置いてありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。まだ支払いはしていないので、取りに戻ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未払のまま席へ戻る許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I haven't paid yet; may I go back to get it?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask permission to return to your seat before paying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どうぞ。伝票はこちらで確認しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. We're keeping track of your bill here.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布を取りました。この紙幣でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 財布を回収して紙幣を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've got my wallet. I'd like to pay with this banknote.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Retrieve your wallet and hand over a banknote. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お預かりした金額を確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let me check the amount you've handed me.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ほかの小銭は混ぜず、その一枚で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一枚だけで払うと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll pay with just that one note, without adding any other coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify that you will pay with just one banknote. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらがお釣りとレシートです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are your change and receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。席に小銭入れを残していないか見てから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣銭を受け取り私物を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received them. I'll check that I haven't left my coin purse at my seat before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the change and check your belongings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お会計は済みました。忘れ物を確認してお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your payment is complete. Please check for belongings before you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加の注文は幹事さんに伺えばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Should we ask the organizer about additional orders?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は先に帰るので、この後は隣の佐藤さんにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 幹事の交代先を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm leaving early, so please ask Mr. Sato next to me from now on.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Identify the person taking over as organizer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今までの注文も引き継いでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you briefed him on the orders so far too?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。最後に頼んだ二品だけ、控えを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未引継ぎの注文控えを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Could you show me the record of just the last two dishes I ordered?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the order record that has not yet been handed over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらです。二品ともまだ届いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here it is. Neither of the two dishes has arrived yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 佐藤さんに、未到着の二品として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未到着の注文を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll tell Mr. Sato that those two dishes haven't arrived yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the orders that have not arrived. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お会計は最後にまとめるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you planning to settle the bill together at the end?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。私の分は本人に渡しますが、お店への精算はまだです。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個人間支払いと店の精算を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll give him my share, but we haven't settled the bill with the restaurant yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish payment between individuals from settling with the restaurant. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。残る方に最終確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please ask the people staying to make the final checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 佐藤さんに会計もお願いしました。これからの確認は本人へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後任の了承を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've asked Mr. Sato to handle the bill too. Please check with him directly from now on.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that your replacement has agreed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。以後は佐藤さんに伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll ask Mr. Sato from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文の確認です。同じお皿が二つ入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'm checking your order. There are two of the same dish on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。一つ頼んだつもりで、もう一度押してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二重注文の原因を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. I meant to order one, but I pressed the button again.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain what caused the duplicate order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一皿はもう準備に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have already started preparing one of them.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 準備前のほうだけ、取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 準備前だけの取消を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can you cancel just the one that hasn't been started yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to cancel only the dish that has not been started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。準備中の一皿はそのままお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We'll still serve the dish that is being prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。他の注文は変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他の注文を維持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'm not changing the other orders.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the other orders unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 画面の一覧も見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you look at the list on the screen too?

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この一皿が残っていれば合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 残す注文を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If this one dish remains, that's correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the order you want to keep. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 訂正後の表示は一皿です。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: The corrected display shows one dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。次から押した後に一覧を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正表示と次の確認方法を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed it. Next time, I'll check the list after pressing the button.
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected display and explain how you will check next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、一皿をお持ちします。ほかの注文も順にお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-017-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll bring you one dish. We'll serve your other orders in turn too.
